meta.name: golden_synthetic
meta.description: Synthetic golden cases, kept apart from the legacy golden sets (whose results stay comparable): invented documents for cases the legacy sets do not cover. Each case is a single-page PDF written from `rows` (`jav/synthetic_pdf.py`; three spaces separate the columns of a row) and scored only on the fields named in `expected`. Run with `python -m jav.cli golden --arm S --type <type> --synthetic`; the rows go to runs/*_synthetic_<arm>.jsonl. Every value is invented; the tax numbers and VAT ids are on the data guard's allow list.

changelog.note: 151 (backlog F-outgoing-invoice-S-path; DECISIONS 151): eight outgoing invoices (our company the issuer): English and Hungarian two-column layouts, francs to an EU customer with the VAT summary converted into forints, dollars and euros to Hungarian customers, reverse charge, a corrective invoice with negative amounts, an exempt invoice to a private person without a tax number, an order and a contract number beside the invoice number. Built by the measurer, so a result on them is measured on its own examples.

127 (5th group, round B; backlog Q-credit-note and Q-receipt, the owner's decisions of 2026-10-07): a Hungarian and a foreign credit note (the own number, not the referenced original invoice's) and two foreign receipts without an invoice number (receipt number > transaction id; never the order number).
